description: Assign thermal clump pebble surface properties. The value a is assigned to the surface property with name s. Any number of name-value pairs can be specified.

examples.description: Assign a surface property consumed by thermal contact models

notes: Values are stored on the thermal pebbles, not on the clump.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC2D and PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (state grade): the value lands on the thermal pebbles - clump.thermal.pebble.prop reads 1000.0 back on all six consoles (clump.thermal.prop itself is write-only in 7.0/9.8 FISH and reads 0 on 6.00).
